answer: Persistent session ledger. Each identity must hold a verifiable history of continuous, time-stamped interactions, like sediment layers in shale. Rewards and voting weight unlock only after uninterrupted participation; any gap resets the clock. An attacker cannot buy history, only rent it, paying sustained human or compute attention per fake identity across an ocean of parallel sessions. Because deep history is required to withdraw value, the lagoon of idle sockpuppets yields nothing, forcing ongoing operational cost.
